menu:4042940:1.text: Wanna join us for a round?

menu:4042950:1.text: Could you lend me a hand? Thanks!
menu:4042950:1.source_cn: 要帮我赶鸭子吗？谢谢你！

say:1:1224601001:1.text: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, I need a favor from you.
say:1:1224601001:1.male: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, I need a favor from you.
say:1:1224601001:1.female: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, I need a favor from you.

say:2:1224601002:0.text: The docks are almost good to go.
say:2:1224601002:0.source_cn: 码头那边收拾得差不多了，可以恢复正常通航了。
say:2:1224601002:0.male: The docks are almost good to go.
say:2:1224601002:0.female: The docks are almost good to go.

say:3:1224601003:1.text: But I can't find <style="highlight">Aldi the craftsman and Otto the sailor</style> anywhere.
say:3:1224601003:1.source_cn: 但<style=highlight>工匠埃迪和水手奥特...
say:3:1224601003:1.male: But I can't find <style="highlight">Aldi the craftsman and Otto the sailor</style> anywhere.
say:3:1224601003:1.female: But I can't find <style="highlight">Aldi the craftsman and Otto the sailor</style> anywhere.

say:4:1224601004:1.text: My hands are full right now. Could you check in with them for me?
say:4:1224601004:1.source_cn: 我走不开，能请你去问问他们的情况吗？
say:4:1224601004:1.male: My hands are full right now. Could you check in with them for me?
say:4:1224601004:1.female: My hands are full right now. Could you check in with them for me?

say:0:1224602001:0.text: Here we are at the docks. Where's <style="stress">Aldi the craftsman</style>?

say:1:1224602002:0.text: There's a guy over there playing cards. Could he be Aldi?
say:1:1224602002:0.source_cn: 看那边打牌的那人，卢卡说的就是他吧。

say:2:1224603001:0.source_cn: 哎哟……今天手气真不错啊。

say:3:1224603002:1.text: We're playing <style="highlight">Century Quest</style> here. You want in?
say:3:1224603002:1.male: We're playing <style="highlight">Century Quest</style> here. You want in?
say:3:1224603002:1.female: We're playing <style="highlight">Century Quest</style> here. You want in?

say:4:1224603003:1.text: You're Aldi, right? Lucca wants you back at the docks!
say:4:1224603003:1.source_cn: 你是埃迪吧？卢卡喊你回码头工作啦！

say:5:1224603004:1.text: I don't understand the rush, especially since the port's been closed for so long.
say:5:1224603004:1.source_cn: 急什么，封都封了那么多天，这下又赶着叫人出海？

say:6:1224603005:1.text: Can't you see I'm on a winning streak now? I'll go back once I lose. Fancy joining in?
say:6:1224603005:1.source_cn: 今天难得这么顺，等什么时候输了，我再回去。你也来一把？
say:6:1224603005:1.male: Can't you see I'm on a winning streak now? I'll go back once I lose. Fancy joining in?
say:6:1224603005:1.female: Can't you see I'm on a winning streak now? I'll go back once I lose. Fancy joining in?

say:1:1224604001:1.text: Alright, I've had enough fun today.
say:1:1224604001:1.male: Alright, I've had enough fun today.
say:1:1224604001:1.female: Alright, I've had enough fun today.

say:2:1224604002:0.text: I'm going back to work now. Catch you later, card buddy!
say:2:1224604002:0.source_cn: 娱乐时间结束，该回去干活了，再见，牌友！
say:2:1224604002:0.male: I'm going back to work now. Catch you later, card buddy!
say:2:1224604002:0.female: I'm going back to work now. Catch you later, card buddy!

say:0:1224605001:0.text: Aldi's headed back. Now, let's look for <style="stress">Otto the sailor</style>.
say:0:1224605001:0.source_cn: 埃迪往回走了，我们去找<style=stress>水手...

say:1:1224605002:0.text: Someone's rounding up ducks over there; he should be Otto!
say:1:1224605002:0.source_cn: 那里有个在赶鸭子的人，应该是奥特！

say:3:1224606002:1.text: Otto, Lucca wants you to get back to work.
say:3:1224606002:1.source_cn: 奥特，卢卡喊你回去复工啦。

say:4:1224606003:1.text: Round up the ducks for me first, and I'll go back.
say:4:1224606003:1.source_cn: 你们先帮我把鸭子赶回来，我就回去。

say:1:1224607001:0.text: Finally, these noisy ducks are back where they belong...
say:1:1224607001:0.source_cn: 这群叽叽喳喳不听话的鸭子总算回去了 ……

say:2:1224607002:1.text: I'm ready to get back to work now. Thank you!
say:2:1224607002:1.source_cn: 我也可以回码头安心干活了，谢谢你啊。
say:2:1224607002:1.male: I'm ready to get back to work now. Thank you!
say:2:1224607002:1.female: I'm ready to get back to work now. Thank you!

say:0:1224608001:0.text: Let's inform Lucca of our progress!
say:0:1224608001:0.source_cn: 我们去找卢卡汇报一下进展吧！

say:1:1224609001:0.text: Aldi and Otto are back at work now. Thanks, <style="stress"><player_name></style>.
say:1:1224609001:0.source_cn: 埃迪和奥特刚刚都回到岗位了，<style=stress...
say:1:1224609001:0.male: Aldi and Otto are back at work now. Thanks, <style="stress"><player_name></style>.
say:1:1224609001:0.female: Aldi and Otto are back at work now. Thanks, <style="stress"><player_name></style>.

say:2:1224609002:1.text: After such a long lockdown, it's natural for everyone to feel unmotivated... I really appreciate what you did for me this time.
say:2:1224609002:1.source_cn: 经过了之前的长期封锁，大伙难免消沉…辛苦你了。
say:2:1224609002:1.male: After such a long lockdown, it's natural for everyone to feel unmotivated... I really appreciate what you did for me this time.
say:2:1224609002:1.female: After such a long lockdown, it's natural for everyone to feel unmotivated... I really appreciate what you did for me this time.

say:3:1224609003:1.text: By opening the docks, we're showing everyone our commitment to reviving Rustport—this is what Sonja said.
say:3:1224609003:1.source_cn: 现在开放港口，也是让大家看到血薇帮决心提振锈锚港的决心...
say:3:1224609003:1.male: By opening the docks, we're showing everyone our commitment to reviving Rustport—this is what Sonja said.
say:3:1224609003:1.female: By opening the docks, we're showing everyone our commitment to reviving Rustport—this is what Sonja said.

say:4:1224609004:1.text: I don't quite get it, but I believe Sonja will make things better around here.
say:4:1224609004:1.source_cn: 这些话，其实我不懂。但我相信索尼娅会让这里越来越好。
say:4:1224609004:1.male: I don't quite get it, but I believe Sonja will make things better around here.
say:4:1224609004:1.female: I don't quite get it, but I believe Sonja will make things better around here.
